row.title: QUNIVERSE-CUT-1: no runtime dependency on the Quniverse account
row.body: Quniverse account assumed gone (Rowan 2026-11-21). All four zones, mail relay and the PS backend URL now live in the ultrastable account. singleaccount --check scans runtime code for Quniverse/QNFO hosts, repos and resources. Social relay on qnfo-social is moved by the social-module thread.
